title: Rejected live pool settings leave management getters consistent
summary: Rejected pool settings now leave the Spring and JDK getters in agreement. A management caller recovered from a rejected size increase and ended at core and maximum two.

change.description: ThreadPoolTaskExecutor now records a new core size, maximum size or keep-alive value only after the initialized JDK executor accepts the change.

notes: The parent advertised the rejected core size and consequently tried another invalid update. Every pool was initialized before inspection and shut down afterward.
